dropped.hotel: constant after filtering to City Hotel
dropped.adr: raw value contains a data error -> use adr_clean
dropped.required_car_parking_spaces: suspected leakage (0% cancellation), no room/revenue use

population_rule: group_block if market_segment == Groups OR deposit_type == Non Refund OR dup_group_size >= 5; else individual
population_note: group_block is an inferred proxy, not a verified group label (customer_type is not used). dup_group_size comes from snapshot attributes of the booking-day cohort; its booking-time availability is not verified. A strict booking-time experiment must drop/rebuild the block-size features AND re-derive this rule. Sensitivity: notebook 03, Section 2.0.1.

feature_sets.booking_time: PRIMARY. numeric + categorical of the population. Score time = booking entry; every booking eligible.
feature_sets.pre_arrival: SECONDARY. booking_time inputs + pre_arrival_extra. Score time = fixed horizon before arrival (set in F1); only bookings created and still active (not cancelled) at score time are eligible (filter implemented in F1).

excluded_features.booking_changes: cumulative number of changes until check-in or cancellation -> future information
excluded_features.has_booking_changes: flag of booking_changes -> same future information
excluded_features.otb_ratio_at_booking: denominator = room capacity estimated from realised stays incl. 2017 test period; redundant with drv_otb_rooms_at_booking
excluded_features.room_type_capacity_share: capacity estimated from realised stays incl. 2017 test period; redundant with reserved_room_type

scope_note: Retrospective prototype: field values come from a near-arrival PMS snapshot; ADR and other mutable fields may differ from their booking-time values. modeling_dataset.csv is already filtered to exclude_from_model == False (data-quality filter only); the pre_arrival eligibility filter (created and still active at score time) is applied in F1.
test_note: EDA (notebook 03, sections 2.0-2.3, 2.6-2.8) used 2017 labels: the 2017 test set is a partially explored holdout. Choose thresholds / tune on a validation period inside the training years.
